title: A month of loaves
description: Equal-width bins count readings from zero, with the median written beside its rule.

props.name: data
props.description: { id, value } readings with unique nonempty IDs. Null and non-finite values are unavailable: they are counted in the caption, never binned.

props.name: binWidth
props.description: Positive, finite bin width in the measurement's unit. At most 60 bins are drawn.

props.name: binStart
props.description: Left edge of the first bin, at or below the lowest reading. Defaults to the lowest reading rounded down to a multiple of binWidth.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement heading and tooltip unit. Defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Plural noun for what is counted, used in the caption and tooltips. Defaults to readings.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats bin edges, the median and tooltips. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; scoped finite motion honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect bins through Recharts.
